title.narrative: Life Saving Nutrition and Protection Assistance for Women and Children

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtGHIV Africa will implement a 6-month nutrition project across Nganzai, Kaga, and Jere LGAs of Borno State, and Gujba LGA in Yobe State. The intervention will integrate nutrition, GBV, and child protection services, with GHIV Africa leading the nutrition component in all four LGAs. In Jere and Gujba LGAs, the GBV response will be implemented by Godiya, while RIA Initiative will implement on child protection/GBV services.ltbrgtThe project targets 15300 individuals, prioritizing the most vulnerable especially women and children in line with the NHF 2025 second allocation strategy ltbrgtTo promote sustainability, all nutrition services will be delivered through existing government health facilities. Under the IMAM component, four Outpatient Therapeutic Programs (OTPs) will be established across Nganzai LGA in Borno State and Gujba LGA in Yobe State. These will support the early detection and treatment of severe and moderate acute malnutrition in children under five, while also providing rountine medication.ltbrgtIn addition, other nutrition interventions will be implemented across all four LGAs. MIYCN counselling will equip pregnant and breastfeeding women (PBWG) and caregivers with practical knowledge on optimal infant and young child feeding practices, including exclusive breastfeeding and dietary diversity, to help prevent malnutrition.ltbrgtThe project will establish 60 Mother-to-Mother (MtM) Support Groups, each led by a trained lead mother and comprising 15 members across different caregiver categories, as well as 20 Father-to-Father Support Groups (FTGs) to strengthen family and community engagement in nutrition practices. To address immediate nutritional needs, the project will provide Ready-to-Use Therapeutic Foods (RUTF) to 1,000 severely malnourished children without complications in Nganzai and Gujba LGAs. Additionally, 3000 moderately malnourished children ltbrgtwill receive supplementary feeding through the locally appropriate Tom Brown approach and 200 pregnant and breastfeeding women (PBWG) will receive Supplemental Nutrition Assistance (SNA) using Fresh Food Voucher (FFA).ltbrgtTrained Community Nutrition Mobilizers (CNMs) will coordinate all community group activities. As part of the supplementary nutrition support (Tom Brown approach), the project will establish 125 Tom Brown groups, each led by a trained facilitator. These groups will receive weekly in-kind food recipes for four months (16 rounds).ltbrgtThe groups will meet weekly to prepare Tom Brown flour and distribute a 1.5kg weekly ration to moderately malnourished (MAM) children for up to 8 weeks. In addition, (CNMs) will conduct anthropometric measurements (weight, height, and MUAC), provide counseling on complementary feeding, verify vaccination status, and refer MAM, SAM children including relapsed cases for appropriate medical treatment.ltbrgtMothers and caregivers will be trained on family-led MUAC screening to strengthen coverage and enable the early detection of malnutrition. In addition, the project will implement Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA) to provide targeted cash transfers to vulnerable households, enhancing their access to nutritious food and supporting adherence to treatment regimens.ltbrgtThe GBV component in Jere and Gujba LGAs will target 2,500 women and girls with lifesaving prevention and response services, including of Safe Spaces, provision of PSS, medical support, and referrals for survivors.ltbrgtThe Child Protection component in Gujba LGA will target 2,000 boys and girls. The response will focus on delivering comprehensive case management services, family tracing and reunification, and birth registration support. It will also strengthen community-based mechanisms for addressing child protection concerns. ltbrgtThe project will strengthen local structures, promote community-driven solutions, and ensure protection mainstreaming across all activities. Special emphasis will be placed on the inclusion of persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups .ltbrgtlt/pgt
